The opportunity: 

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team , a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product: 

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

- Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.

- Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.

- Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP) , Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.

- Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.

- Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.

- AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant , which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing: 

- Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.

- Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.

- Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust . Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.

- Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.

- Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.

- Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.

- Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.

- Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

- Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.

- Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).

- Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.

- Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.

- Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.

- Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.

- Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For: 

- Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.

- A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.

- Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.

- Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.

- Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.

- Open source contribution or maintainership.

- Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €85,000 - €107,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients 

- Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

- Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get 

- Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

- We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

- Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

- No micromanagement, no screen trackers

- Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

- Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for 

Senior Data Engineers with: 

- 
4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

- 
Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required

- 
Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory

- 
You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production.

- 
You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents).

- 
Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.

- 
You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision.

-

We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.

description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 

At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .

And we’re only just getting started! 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users. 

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models . On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better. 

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead , working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles. 

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role. 

Key Responsibilities

- Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

- Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

- Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

- Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

- Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

- Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

- You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

- You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business , not an experimental side feature

- Fine-tuning is core to your experience

- Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face , with hands-on GPU training and debugging

- You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

- You can take work beyond notebooks into production 

- You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

- You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content , including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

- Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

- Multilingual LLMs

- Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

- Multimodal models

- Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth : From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply! 

To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice . 

Compensation: €75K – €125K

title: Client Manager, Retail Collaboration
description:
As a Client Manager, you will be a trusted advisor to a portfolio of clients, driving adoption, engagement, and business value through NielsenIQ 's proprietary solutions. You'll build strong relationships, lead strategic conversations, and help clients unlock new opportunities through data-driven insights and innovation. 

Acting as the voice of the customer, you'll partner across Product, Analytics, and Commercial teams to shape the future of our solutions while delivering an exceptional client experience. If you're passionate about retail, data, and building meaningful partnerships, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact. 

Responsibilities:

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with client stakeholders across Retail Collaboration programs, driving engagement, adoption, and business growth. 

- Serve as a trusted advisor to internal and external clients, being a strong voice, resolving issues proactively and consistently delivering measurable business value. 

- Train and consult clients on NielsenIQ solutions, datasets, and analytics, providing guidance on best practices for integrating insights into key business processes/workflows such as category reviews, joint business planning, assortment optimization, and product innovation. 

- Lead onboarding, training, and enablement activities, including the development and delivery of live and recorded product demonstrations, workshops, and educational content. 

- Manage and prioritize multiple client initiatives and collaboration programs simultaneously, ensuring successful execution against timelines, objectives, and stakeholder expectations. 

- Partner with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to identify client needs, validate requirements, and deliver high-quality solutions and materials. 

- Document, refine, and optimize processes and program workflows to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and the overall client experience. 

- Perform other duties as assigned. 

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Retail Management, Supply Chain, Data Analytics, or a related field. 

- 5+ years of experience in client management, customer success, account management, retail analytics, category management, consulting, or a related field. 

- Experience working with retailers, suppliers, CPG/FMCG manufacturers, syndicated market data, or retail technology solutions. 

- Proven ability to build, manage, and grow client relationships while driving adoption, retention, and business outcomes. 

- Strong consultative, communication, and presentation skills, with experience delivering business reviews, training, and strategic recommendations to client stakeholders. 

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client programs, projects, and priorities while navigating competing business needs. 

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable business recommendations.

title: Senior Frontend (Full-stack) Engineer
description:
About Rivia 

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role 

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of user‑facing product experiences that make complex clinical trial data intuitive, actionable, and delightful. You will own major parts of our web application, from frontend architecture and UX to integration with backend services, while remaining comfortable contributing across the stack when needed. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to ship high‑quality features iteratively and help shape the future of our platform.

To succeed in this role, you should have a passion for iterative product development and possess a strategic, analytical mindset. You should be comfortable navigating the uncertainties of a startup environment, adaptable to shifting priorities, and driven to transform the pharmaceutical industry. Embrace the challenge of building the future of clinical trial technology and help realize Rivia's vision of becoming the definitive unified data infrastructure for clinical trials.

Our stack 

Some technologies we use today: Typescript & React (must-haves for this role), Java, Python, Spring, Postgres, GPT-4, AWS, Kubernetes.

There's no need to be a prior expert in our stack; it's more important that you learn new technologies quickly.

What excites you 

- Building high‑quality, performant web interfaces that delight end users and make complex data easy to understand.

- Owning features end‑to‑end on the frontend, from initial idea and technical design through implementation, testing, and rollout.

- Collaborating with design and product to refine UX, interaction patterns, and visual polish.

- Occasionally working across the full stack (APIs, data models, cloud services) to unblock frontend work and ship complete product slices.

- Thriving in a fast‑paced startup environment where you have autonomy and make strategic decisions that impact users and the team.

- Leveraging the latest advancements in technology, particularly in AI, to develop great products.

Responsibilities 

- Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of core frontend systems and user interfaces for our clinical trial data platform.

- Build robust, accessible, and responsive React/Typescript applications that integrate seamlessly with our backend services and data infrastructure.

- Work across the stack when required (e.g., defining APIs, adjusting backend endpoints, or working with cloud services) to deliver end‑to‑end features.

- Provide technical leadership, helping to design scalable architectures that can support our growth to a multi‑million‑dollar business.

- Address and resolve performance and scalability challenges, both in the frontend and, when needed, in the broader system.

- Level up your teammates by providing mentorship and guidance

- Coordinate closely with sales and customer success teams to ensure technical developments align with customer needs and business objectives

What Excites us 

- Extensive experience with Typescript and React

- Previous experience working in a startup environment

- Minimum four years of relevant experience

- A proven track record of taking initiative and leading projects or teams

- Drivers, not passengers

- Excellent problem-solving abilities focused on delivering practical and timely solutions

- Strong technical knowledge and expertise in current and emerging technologies

Hiring Process 

Our hiring process takes 2-4 weeks over four distinct stages:

- Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

- Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

- Coding Interview: 60-minute online exercise. 

- Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values 

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

- In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

- Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

- Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

- Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

- Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

- Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

The Payments team owns how ElevenLabs charges customers: billing, usage tracking, pricing and payments across self-serve and enterprise. Everything we do has to be correct, because it underpins the company's revenue and is immediately visible to every customer and team.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) to expand and evolve our payments systems. Your responsibilities might include:

- Building and maintaining usage tracking so that requests are metered accurately without impacting latency.

- Enabling pricing and Growth experiments with Growth and product teams.

- Expertise in Python.

- A strong background in backend development.

- Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.

- Strong test design and security fundamentals.

- Care and attention to detail when changing live systems that handle money.

- The ability to learn a large existing system quickly and to debug complex production issues.

Bonus:

- Experience with payment processing providers, or with billing and usage-based pricing systems

- Experience with stream processing or high-throughput event pipelines.

- Experience working with finance, tax or audit requirements.

- Experience with Kubernetes.

Location

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists 

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do 

Product contribution 

- Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.

- Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.

- Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.

- Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.

- Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship 

- Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.

- Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.

- Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.

- Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.

- Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle 

- Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.

- Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.

- Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership 

- Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.

- Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.

- Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.

- Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring 

- Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.

- Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.

- Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.

- Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.

- Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.

- Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.

- Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.

- The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.

- Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications 

- Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.

- Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.

- Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.

- Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.

- A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.

- Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains 

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

- Ruby on Rails

- Go

- AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC

- PostgreSQL

- Redis and Sidekiq

- Git internals

- GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture

- Kubernetes and containers

- Terraform

- Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis

- Vue and TypeScript

- APIs and automation

- DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not 

This role isn't:

- A generic field engineering role.

- A proof-of-concept factory.

- A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.

- A customer-specific customization function.

- Unbilled Professional Services.

- A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.

- An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures 

Success in this role may include:

- Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.

- Fixing product bugs or contributing features.

- Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.

- Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.

- Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.

- Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

- Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.

- Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team 

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile 

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements 

- Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

- Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

- Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

- Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

- Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Treasury Lead
location: London or remote within the UK
description:
About Griffin 

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do 

Our culture 

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture. 

The Team 

Our vision is that our Finance team plays a central part of the business, somewhere the Board can rely on to support strategic planning. In this our treasury team keeps us safely funded and liquid and gives the Board and ALCO numbers they can trust. As we add products and markets, the team is growing. As second hire to the team, you’ll report directly to our Treasurer, sitting at the heart of how we capture, report, analyse and manage risk to support how we optimise Griffin’s balance sheet.

The opportunity 

Treasury at a fintech bank is different. You’ll see real-time payment flows and deposit behaviour that a conventional bank never sees. You’ll work directly with our Treasurer to build our treasury processes, reporting and systems rather than inherit them. You’ll contribute to management of liquidity as a Direct FPS participant, use of facilities within the Bank of England’s Sterling Monetary Framework (SMF), card issuing and stablecoin infrastructure.

What success looks like 

By month 3, you’ll understand our business and processes, run daily reporting with Michael’s review and handle daily cash positioning, including our Bank of England reserve account. By month 6, you’ll own daily and monthly reporting and run intraday cash management independently, including testing the SMF. You’ll have drafted ALCO papers and credit reviews, delivered your first automation improvements and contributed to the impact assessment for Direct FPS or a similar product launch.

To do this you’ll own 

- Daily and intraday reporting on liquidity, capital, interest rate risk, funding capacity and asset encumbrance, with every output sense-checked before it goes out

- Risk monitoring against our risk appetite: limits, triggers and early warning indicators, forecast-versus-actual reviews, and stress tests you design with the Treasurer

- Intraday cash management and liquidity forecasting: cash positioning, payments and transfers, depositor behaviour and outflow assumptions

- Monthly management reporting, including interest income, margin and customer profitability, the ALCO pack, inputs to regulatory returns, and contributions to the ILAAP and ICAAP

- Dealing operations: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations, settlements and collateral movements, plus credit analysis on counterparties and issuers. You’ll also cover for the Treasurer with brokers, treasury bill auctions and SMF drawdowns

- Automating manual steps, closing control gaps, and documenting procedures that mean knowledge never sits with just two people

- Maintaining our treasury bank and broker mandates

We expect you to shape this role 

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background 

To succeed in the role, we're looking for people who have:

- 5+ years in a bank treasury function (e.g. middle-office, ALM or balance sheet management), measuring and reporting liquidity and capital from economic and regulatory perspectives. You will have produced reports hands-on rather than reviewed them

- Strong prudential knowledge across liquidity, capital and leverage (e.g. CRR, Basel III, LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ILAAP, ICAAP), and hands-on exposure to the dealing lifecycle: pre- and post-trade checks, confirmations and settlements

- Advanced Excel skills (e.g. data tables, scenario analysis, VBA), plus the attention to detail and reconciliation discipline to sense-check everything you produce

- An analytical, inquisitive mindset, with a habit of automating what’s manual

- The organisation and drive to work autonomously, remotely and asynchronously, and the appetite for the breadth and ambiguity of building in an early-stage bank

- A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) 

Ideally, you would also:

- Hold a treasury or accountancy qualification (ACT, CertBALM, FRM, CFA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

- Bring Python, SQL, Power BI or AI skills

- Knowledge of Direct FPS and Bank of England SMF facilities

- Experience implementing or using treasury or ALM systems

What can we offer you? 

- Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

- Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

- Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays

- Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

- Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

- Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

- Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

- Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

- AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

- Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks. 

How long will the process take? 

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

- Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

- Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

- Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

- Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

- Step 5 : Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here .

How do I apply? 

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Under representation 

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are 

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

- Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

- Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

- Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.

- Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.

- Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

What We're Looking For 

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help develop and scale the Lightning AI platform, spanning APIs, infrastructure, billing, security, and integrations. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key features and drive them end-to-end, working closely with engineering, product, and design to ship high-quality, iterative improvements. This is an opportunity to build systems that support real-world machine learning workloads at scale.

This role is based in one of our hubs (Seattle, NYC, SF, or London), with a minimum of 2 in-office days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You’ll Do 

- Write readable/testable/efficient code in Go (Golang).

- Build deep expertise in our technology stack to deliver new features, improve system stability, and increase overall performance.

- Partner with engineering and product leaders on developing the Lightning product while using your experience to set the technical direction for large projects.

- Evaluate, strengthen, and document technical architecture, tools, and processes.

- Maintain software quality, implement automation, drive continuous delivery, and reduce time to production while proactively reducing technical debt.

- Mentor and coach engineers on system design, operating in high uncertainty, and problem-solving to create a supportive, inclusive environment where each engineer can grow.

What You’ll Need 

- Extensive experience writing efficient, maintainable code in Go. Familiarity with best practices in testing, readability, and optimization is essential.

- Broad knowledge of backend and frontend systems, with experience building and scaling APIs, CLI tools, billing systems, and security protocols. Exposure to frontend frameworks is a plus.

- Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure and designing systems that are reliable, performant, and scalable. Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a strong advantage.

- Proven ability to take ownership of key features and drive end-to-end development

- Commitment to software quality, test automation, and continuous delivery. Experience proactively managing technical debt and speeding up time to production.

- Hands-on experience as a backend or product engineer in a SaaS technology company

- Communication and collaboration with engineers, product managers, and designers

- Ability to operate in high uncertainty and rapidly changing environments

Compensation 

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:

$180,000 — $250,000 USD

- Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

- Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.

- Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).

- Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.

- Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.

- Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.

- Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.

- Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.

- Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.

- In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Headquarters: 

URL: https://oneimaging.com 

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do: 

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first) 

- Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.

- Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.

- Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.

- Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

- Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.

- Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.

- Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

- Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.

- Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

- Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.

- Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.

- Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

- Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.

- Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.

- Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you: 

- 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.

- Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.

- Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.

- Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.

- Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.

- Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.

- Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

- AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.

- Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.

- MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.

- Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.

- Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.

The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a OneImaging recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to candidateprotection@oneimaging.com . 

Equal Employment Opportunity: 

OneImaging is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

OneImaging is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@oneimaging.com .

title: Software Engineer II (Frontend)

-

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one.

What you’ll do

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go fast, that works for us.

- Hands-on integration experience with at least one ERP system (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS, ABAS or similar), ideally more than one. You have built or maintained native interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience writing production code in Go.

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in ERP systems: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Experience with both cloud and on-premise ERP environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access or API rate limits in cloud ERPs).

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information 

- Location: We have an office in Zurich, London, Munich and Cologne, hybrid with 3+ office days per week in those locations or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One , Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

- 
10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

- 
Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python , the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

- 
Strong system design : distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises , including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

title: AI/ML Engineer - Production AI & LLM Systems (India)
description:
Headquarters: India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/vBHEuzwk8ghJwdk43HHAzt/jobs-at-volga-partners 

AI Engineer | India 

Department: Engineering 
Reports To: Product & Engineering Leadership 
Location: India - Fully Remote 
Employment Type: Full-Time 
Experience Level: Mid-Level 
Compensation: ₹15,00,000 – ₹22,00,000 per year (15–22 LPA), commensurate with experience and technical expertise 

Position Overview 

The AI Engineer at Volga Partners will design, develop, and deploy advanced, production-ready AI solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation technologies.

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients.

Key Responsibilities 

AI System Development 

- Design, develop, and deploy AI systems, including LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows, and ML/DL solutions. 
- Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. 
- Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. 
- Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. 
- Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. 
Production & Optimization 

- Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. 
- Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. 
- Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. 
Collaboration

- Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. 
- Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. 
- Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. 
Research & Experimentation 

- Read and evaluate ML research papers. 
- Implement promising methods and reproducing results where applicable. 
- Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems. 
- Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives. 

Working Relationships 

The AI Engineer will collaborate with: 

- Engineering leadership and product teams. 
- Software engineers and backend developers. 
- Global AI research and development teams. 

Success in This Role 

Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. 

You should be able to: 

- Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. 
- Translate research into practical engineering solutions. 
- Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. 
- Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. 
- Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. 

Work Environment 

This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. 

Required Work Schedule 

This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time?

The ability to consistently work the assigned schedule is a required and non-negotiable condition of this role. Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours and maintaining reliable availability throughout the assigned shift.

Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected

Our Hiring Process 

We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 

1. Initial Recruiter Screening 

An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners. 

2. Practical Skills Assessment 

Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. 

The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 

3. Assessment Review 

Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. 

Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage.

4. Technical / Coding Interview
Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge

5. Final Interview – CTO 

A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. 

Required Qualifications 

- 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. 
- Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. 
- Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. 
- Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. 
- Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. 
- Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. 
- Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
- Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods. 
- SQL database knowledge. 
- Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain. 
- Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and model-serving infrastructure. 
- Open-source contributions or experience reproducing research results. 

Compensation & Benefits 

- Annual Compensation: ₹15,00,000-₹22,00,000 (15-22 LPA), based on experience and technical expertise. 
- Contract and payment administration facilitated through Deel. 
- 90-day probationary period. 
- Benefits eligibility upon successful completion of probation, including: 
- Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy. 
- Holiday pay for company-observed holidays. 
- Career growth and professional development opportunities.
