title: Senior Software Engineer (Home Energy)
description:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

- 
Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

- 
Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

- 
Build with AI as a normal part of how you work, and turn what you learn into tools, skills and processes the rest of the team picks up, so the leverage is shared rather than personal.

- 
Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

- 
Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

- 
Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

- 
Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

- 
Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: 

- 
Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

- 
AI is a real part of how our engineers work, and we expect a senior engineer to be fluent with it. You use AI day to day, you understand where it helps and where it falls short, and you think about your work in terms of what AI can take on. If you're not fully there yet, you're eager to get there fast.

- 
Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

- 
Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

- 
Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

- 
Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

- 
A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

- 
Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

- 
Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

- 
Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

- 
On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

- 
Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

- 
A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

- 
Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

- 
Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

- 
Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

- 
Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

- 
Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

- 
Flexible, human-first culture.

- 
Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

- 
Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

- 
Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster.

This is a role where you are expected to be in the lab, talk to scientists and lab technicians on a day-to-day basis. You will see how science is done in the lab, and then think hard about how to improve its impact. If you’re excited by complex workflows and the friction of real-life lab work, as well the power of data and AI, this position is for you.

What You'll Do

- Own the lab-based data generation pipelines: to enable data transfer at scale from the lab to the cloud. This will involve building and improving production codebases that turn high-throughput experimental readouts into validated insights.

- Facilitate lab operations : Maintain and/or build tools to accelerate the work of Orakl Oncology scientists.

- Define and own the canonical data model: Design the unified data model that structures our data and is adopted across teams, ensuring data can be joined across modalities: experimental, clinical, omics, and clinical-trial event reporting.

- Design and own data quality pipeline: Build QC that flags data quality at transfer time, and turn it into feedback loops so scientists can spot experimental errors early and integrate checks into their routine.

- Support lab initiatives: such as automation initiatives, the development of experimental tooling to help lab scientists and technicians.

- Drive operational efficiency: make sure that wet lab work is optimized to benefit the most from our resources (human and experimental) and ensure efficient contract and research delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

- Masters or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

- 3+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining Python code in production 

- Strong hacker and tinkerer mindset. You like building things that have a real world effects.

- Excellent proficiency in Python and SQL , and solid data-engineering skills: pipeline design and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent), version control (Git), testing/CI, and observability.

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data-storage best practices.

- Comfortable working with noisy, real-world experimental data and directly alongside non-technical scientists.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with experimental, assay, or high-throughput screening data.

- Working knowledge of biology, ideally in oncology, cell biology, or drug discovery.

- Experience with image analysis / computer vision applied to microscopy data.

- Familiarity with lab data systems / LIMS (e.g. Benchling) and experimental workflows.

Who You Are

- Curious and autonomous: you dig into scientists' bottlenecks, connect the dots across teams, and ship without waiting for perfect specifications.

- A fast shipper: you get working solutions into production and iterate, rather than polishing in isolation.

- A strong communicator: you gather needs from and explain your work to non-technical scientists, acting as the data bridge across the lab and beyond.

- At ease in a complex and interdisciplinary environment: you thrive with messy data, evolving priorities, and external constraints that come with a science-first, non-pure-tech setting.

Why Join Orakl

- Own the wet-lab data backbone of a techbio platform from the ground up: your work directly shapes how we discover and validate cancer therapies.

- Sit at one of the most interdisciplinary intersections in techbio: data science, production engineering, and experimental oncology, side-by-side every day.

- High autonomy and immediately visible impact, in a fast-growing, mission-driven company backed by leading investors.

Interview Process

- HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

- Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

- Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

- Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

- Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Working at CreateFuture 

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to own the technical direction of a data engagement, working with AWS data services, platforms like Snowflake and Databricks, Python, and PySpark across our data team. You’ll lead a team of data engineers, setting the standards for how pipelines and architecture are designed, built, and operated, while staying hands-on with the most complex technical challenges. You’ll work closely with client stakeholders and CreateFuture’s wider engineering capability to make sure delivery is both technically excellent and commercially sound.

What you'll be doing: 

- Own the technical direction of a data engagement, setting standards for pipeline architecture, data modelling, orchestration, testing, and operational readiness

- Lead and technically direct a team of data engineers, allocating work, reviewing designs and code, and unblocking technical challenges

- Design and evolve data platform architecture on AWS (e.g. AWS Glue, EMR, S3/Lake Formation, Redshift, Athena) alongside platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, weighing trade-offs in performance, cost, and maintainability

- Set and enforce CI/CD, testing, observability, and operational practices across the engagement’s data engineering workflows

- Build professional relationships with key client stakeholders, translating business and data requirements into a coherent technical roadmap, with clear estimates, trade-offs, and risks

- Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex issues in live data pipelines, and lead incident response when things go wron

We'd love to talk to you if you: 

- Have extensive hands-on experience designing and operating production data platforms on a modern cloud data stack such as AWS (Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3/Lake Formation), Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable, and can articulate which architectural decisions travel between platforms and which don’t

- Have deep SQL expertise and a strong grasp of data modelling and architecture (Kimball, data vault, medallion/lakehouse patterns, or domain modelling). This is the clearest line between someone who operates a platform and someone who can design on top of it, and it’s provider-agnostic

- Have owned orchestration strategy in production, including dependency design, retries, SLAs, and the observability that tells you a pipeline failed before the client does

- Have designed ingestion from awkward sources (APIs, CDC off operational databases, files that change shape without warning) and set patterns your team can reuse

- Have strong proficiency in Python and PySpark for batch/ELT processing at scale, with production-grade, well-tested code. The bulk of this work is batch and ELT, but you’ll have experience with event-driven or micro-batch pipelines and know where the design assumptions stop holding

- Have led or technically directed a team of data engineers, setting standards for pipeline design, testing, and delivery, and growing the engineers around you

- Have owned CI/CD and operational practices for data engineering workflows across a team or engagement

- Are experienced working directly with client stakeholders, building trust, shaping solutions from ambiguous requirements, and challenging where appropriate

What we’ll offer you: 

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process 

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

- Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 

- Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Full Stack Analytics - Digital Unit Sports (f/m/d)
description:
LE CONTEXTE 

Depuis plus de 50 ans, grâce à ses produits innovants et fort de sa culture reposant sur l’accessibilité, Decathlon ne cesse de réinventer le marché du sport.

Notre mission : rendre durablement les plaisirs et les bienfaits du sport accessibles au plus grand nombre.

Aujourd’hui, nous tirons parti de cette culture de l’innovation et de notre expertise digitale pour qu’un public plus large puisse bénéficier des plaisirs du sport et ce, à l’aide de la technologie. 
Nous créons de nouvelles expériences pour les sportives et sportifs – coaching virtuel, programmes de fidélité, expériences intelligentes en magasin, offres de produits neufs et d’occasion, mais aussi services de location d’une large gamme de produits Decathlon et de partenaires. Notre objectif : créer un écosystème digital de produits et services.

La Digital Unit Sports est au cœur de la transformation et de l’innovation de Décathlon car elle sert les équipes Décathlon en charge de la construction de notre offre globale de produits, de la conception des produits et de leur commercialisation . Saviez-vous que 80% des produits vendus en magasins sont conçus et développés par Decathlon ? Une belle responsabilité !

Tu rejoindras la PIC (Product Info & Content) Data team qui est composée de Data Scientists, Fullstack Analytics, ML engineer et Data & AI PM. 

L’objectif de l’équipe est d'obtenir une information produit et un contenu de qualité supérieure à grande échelle grâce à l'IA et à l'analytics. (#Product content at scale) 

En tant que Full Stack Analytics, tu gèreras de A à Z un projet analytics, en combinant les expertises de l'Analytics Engineering, de la Business Intelligence (BI) et de la Data Analysis pour maximiser la valeur de nos données produits. 

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS 

En tant que Full stack Analytics au sein de l'équipe PIC , vous aurez l'occasion de : 

- Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, Machine Learning Engineer et Data Scientist pour identifier les opportunités d'impact business, exploiter les données pour quantifier les résultats et participer à la planification de la stratégie et de la feuille de route Analytics de l'équipe.

- Modéliser et industrialiser (Analytics Engineering- 60%) : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données et des modèles de données propres, documentés et optimisés dans notre data lakehouse.

- Piloter la Business Intelligence (BI - 30%) : Concevoir des tableaux de bord et des applications analytiques interactives, percutants et self-service pour permettre aux équipes métiers et produits de piloter leur activité en autonomie.

- Délivrer des analyses d'impact (Data Analysis - 10%) : Explorer les données pour identifier des opportunités business, définir des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) pertinents et réaliser des analyses approfondies pour guider la stratégie de l'offre globale de produits.

- Garantir la fiabilité : Mettre en place des tests de qualité de données, du monitoring sur la fraîcheur des données et documenter chaque sujets. 

L’environnement technique 

- Langages : SQL (expert), Python

- Transformation & Orchestration : dbt, Airflow, Astro 

- Data Platform : Databricks , Spark/PySpark , Cloud (AWS / GCP )

- Restitution & BI : Tableau, Streamlit

- CI/CD & Bonnes pratiques : Git, GitHub actions , Docker

CE DONT VOUS AUREZ BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR 

- Expérience : Vous avez au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience sur un rôle combinant l'analyse de données, la BI et l'ingénierie analytique, idéalement sur des cas d'usage à grande échelle.

- Maîtrise technique : Le SQL n'a aucun secret pour vous. Vous maîtrisez les concepts de modélisation de données (Kimball, Data Vault, etc.), l'utilisation de dbt, et vous avez une bonne maîtrise de Python pour l'analyse de données.

- Aisance relationnelle : Vous êtes un excellent communicant, capable de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes face à des interlocuteurs multidisciplinaires (équipes métiers, produit, gouvernance).

- Langues : Vous maîtrisez l’Anglais (contexte international) et pouvez parler en français (conversationnel).

- Culture & Humain : Vous êtes particulièrement sensible à l’impact de la pratique du sport pour les valeurs qu'elle transmet dans la vie en équipe! Vous avez envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS 

- 2 jours de télétravail par semaine ;

- Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

- Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

- Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

- Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Game Engine)
description:
About the Role 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a newly forming team that will own one of the most specialised and business-critical domains in our technology landscape - Game Engine.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, game mathematics, platform, and compliance. You’ll work on the tools, frameworks, and services that enable our mathematicians and game teams to build, validate, run, and monitor game logic in production.

This position is about deep ownership of a very specific technical domain: game engines, mathematical packages, simulation data, RTP monitoring, round details, and integrations with games developed both internally and by external studios.

You’ll be part of a small, experienced team with a high level of responsibility. The impact of this work is direct: incorrect game logic, missing round details, or inaccurate RTP monitoring can affect game delivery timelines, business performance, and regulatory readiness.

If you enjoy working close to complex domain logic, reviewing technical implementations, understanding how games work under the hood, and owning systems where precision matters - this role will feel like home.

Key Responsibilities 

- Own, maintain, and evolve Playson’s Game Engine domain

- Work on internal frameworks and libraries used by mathematicians to implement game logic and mathematical packages.

- Review and validate code written by mathematicians, ensuring quality, correctness, maintainability, and proper usage of internal frameworks.

- Contribute to the development and support of game engines used to run mathematical logic within our platform.

- Support integrations with external game studios by helping build wrappers and bridges between third-party game implementations and Playson’s platform.

- Work with data structures and protocols that connect game logic with frontend and backend systems.

- Contribute to RTP monitoring processes, including validation of production transaction data against simulation data and expected mathematical behaviour.

- Support and evolve tools used for mathematical review, simulations, data files, monitoring, and alerting.

- Implement and maintain round details logic required for regulated markets, ensuring that detailed game round information can be correctly provided to partners and regulators.

- Collaborate closely with mathematicians, backend engineers, platform teams, compliance stakeholders, and product representatives.

- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to ensure a high engineering standard across the Game Engine domain.

- Investigate issues related to game logic, mathematical validation, monitoring, and engine behaviour.

- Participate in minimal on-call responsibilities related to the systems owned by the team, mainly around monitoring, alerts, and domain-specific incidents.

- Take ownership of a highly specialised area where quality, accuracy, and attention to detail are essential.

Requirements 

- Strong software engineering experience, ideally in backend, game engine, gaming, gambling, betting, or simulation-heavy environments.

- Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript, or strong expertise in another OOP language such as C++, Java, C#, Go, or Python.

- Good understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing, debugging, and maintainability.

- Experience reviewing complex code and providing clear technical feedback.

- Ability to understand domain-specific logic and work with technical systems where business rules, mathematics, and engineering are closely connected.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with complex, non-standard technical challenges.

- Experience working with production systems where reliability, accuracy, and correctness are critical.

- Understanding of backend systems, APIs, data flows, and service-to-service communication.

- Ability to collaborate closely with non-engineering technical experts, especially mathematicians or domain specialists.

- Strong ownership mindset and willingness to become a key expert in a narrow but highly important technical domain.

- Product-oriented thinking, with an understanding that games are the core product and engineering decisions directly affect delivery, quality, and compliance.

- English communication skills sufficient for working in an international environment.

Nice to Have 

- Experience in iGaming, gambling, betting, game development, or casino games.

- Experience working with game engines, mathematical engines, simulation tools, or game logic frameworks.

- Background in C++ or experience working with legacy C++ systems.

- Experience with mathematical models, probability-based systems, simulations, random generators, or RTP-related logic.

- Understanding of regulated markets and compliance requirements in iGaming.

- Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical/columnar databases.

- Experience with monitoring, alerting, and production diagnostics.

- Experience with AI-assisted code review or automated validation tools.

- Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.

- Familiarity with Kafka, gRPC, Kubernetes, or AWS.

- Experience integrating third-party games, external studio products, or wrapper-based solutions.

- Ukrainian language skills would be a plus.

What We Offer 

- Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive salary in EUR, subject to annual performance reviews

- Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system

- Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs

- Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort

- Medical Insurance: Receive comprehensive medical insurance for both you and a significant other

- Financial Support for Life Events: We provide financial support during special life events

- Unlimited Paid Vacation: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave

- Unlimited Paid Sick Leave: Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary

- Professional Development: Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training

Recruitment Process 

- HR interview

- Technical interview (with Live coding)

- Final interview 

Join us today!

Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit www.policyme.com .

title: Senior Software Engineer, Services
description:
Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Services to play a foundational role in building the technology behind our digital experiences. This includes designing and building backend services, APIs, event processing systems, and integrations that enable analytics, lifecycle engagement, and downstream data systems.

The role goes beyond feature delivery, developing platform capabilities that support our broader modernization strategy while helping transition the existing delivery model by balancing BAU support with long-term architectural goals.

In addition to hands-on development, responsibilities include providing technical leadership, driving engineering best practices, and mentoring other engineers. The role requires deep backend engineering expertise combined with systems thinking, architectural discipline, and a strong appreciation for scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability.

What You'll Do: 

- Lead Java backend development using Spring, Hibernate, Dropwizard, and related technologies, building scalable microservices for high-volume, highly available digital platforms.

- Design and evolve RESTful APIs, service-to-service communication, and event-driven architectures using Kafka and asynchronous messaging.

- Own resilient internal and third-party integrations, including retry handling, idempotency, monitoring, and operational support.

- Manage event contracts and payload schemas with Product, Analytics, and Engineering, ensuring reliable, well-structured data for downstream CRM, lifecycle, reporting, and analytics systems.

- Define platform-wide API governance, service contracts, versioning, and integration standards.

- Support business-as-usual (BAU) operations while reducing technical debt, simplifying legacy processes, and modernizing architecture through service consolidation.

- Deliver secure, high-performing, observable, and maintainable services through engineering best practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring.

- Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and long-term preventative improvements.

- Lead design reviews, pair programming, and code reviews; mentor engineers and support hiring, onboarding, and career development.

- Shape technical roadmaps with Engineering Managers and Architects, recommending direction and evaluating trade-offs using facts.

- Evaluate emerging backend technologies, including AI-assisted development tools, to improve scalability, reliability, and productivity.

What You'll Bring: 

- 8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep backend expertise and advanced Java proficiency using Spring, Hibernate, Dropwizard, or similar enterprise frameworks.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Systems is preferred.

- Proven expertise in distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, backend integrations, and event-driven architectures using brokers such as Kafka.

- Experience designing scalable, highly available, secure, resilient, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems.

- Working knowledge of Postgres, Oracle, AWS, and infrastructure-as-code practices, plus hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and DevOps.

- Strong observability skills across logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and production diagnostics.

- Ability to lead technical discussions and architectural decisions across teams, balancing immediate delivery with long-term platform scalability.

- Experience partnering with Engineering, Analytics, or BI teams in production and mentoring engineers in Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills in English, communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A self-starter mindset with strong ownership and accountability in complex, evolving environments.

- Exposure to high-traffic, real-time, or transaction-heavy platforms; experience in regulated, high-volume, transaction-heavy environments involving customer/player data, payments, CRM, marketing technology, or real-time event processing is strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with mobile application architecture and platform best practices.

- Redis experience and a background in Data Analytics or Data Engineering are assets.

- Ability to travel occasionally, domestically and internationally. #LI-REMOTE #LI-PROMOTE

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer - FDE (Fullstack)
description:
CSQ427R397

As a Sr Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have: 

- Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration

- Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer

- Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.

- Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.

- Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.

- Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.

- Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.

- Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for: 

- 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering

- Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks

- Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one

- Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals

- Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments

- Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs

- Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.

- Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.

- Documentation and white-boarding skills.

- Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range

- Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

- Travel to customers 20% of the time

- Databricks Certification

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. title: Deployment Strategist
description:
At Ankar, we’re building AI to transform industrial R&D.

From understanding the technology landscape and identifying new invention opportunities to accelerating R&D and bringing products to market, we're inventing how innovation happens.

We work with some of the world's leading enterprises across industries, helping them unlock the value of their knowledge, experts, technical expertise, inventions, and turn ideas into real-world impact. We're the builders of the new age of industrial innovation. 

Join us at a unique moment of scale:

- We've raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the founders of Hugging Face, CEO of Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

- We're already working with the world's most innovative companies including Fortune 500 companies such as L'Oréal.

- Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We're just getting started.

We're growing rapidly, and looking for exceptional people to help us build what comes next.

The Role 

As a Deployment Strategist at Ankar, you'll help chart and build the art of the possible in enterprise R&D. You'll work on the frontlines with some of the world's leading enterprises, tackling their most important innovation challenges and bringing together technology, product and business to deliver real world outcomes.

Your mission is to discover where Ankar can create extraordinary value for our customers, and make that value a reality.

You'll immerse yourself in complex organisations, develop a deep understanding of their people, science, priorities and challenges, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You'll bring curiosity, product intuition, commercial instinct and the ability to connect with people at every level of an organisation, helping them challenge established ways of working, imagine what's possible, and turn that ambition into action.

This isn't a traditional consulting, customer success or technical implementation role. You'll be part strategist, part operator, part product thinker and part builder. You'll need to be equally comfortable working with end users to understand their day-to-day challenges, shaping a proposition with senior executives, and collaborating with engineers to build something that doesn't yet exist.

You'll own outcomes, not just deliverables. From shaping an initial pilot to driving adoption, demonstrating impact and identifying opportunities to expand, you'll play a critical role in building Ankar's most important customer partnerships.

What You'll Do 

Discover and unlock customer value 

- Immerse yourself in customers' businesses, workflows and strategic priorities to identify their most important problems and opportunities.

- Connect the dots between customer needs, technology capabilities and commercial opportunities to define where Ankar can deliver the greatest impact.

- Work with stakeholders from hands-on SMEs to senior executives, challenging assumptions and helping customers reimagine what's possible while building excellent rapport and passion for innovation to enable the work that’s needed.

Own deployments and drive impact 

- Lead customer engagements from early discovery and pilot scoping through deployment, adoption and expansion.

- Translate ambitious, often ambiguous objectives into actionable plans, bringing together customers, engineers, product teams and commercial colleagues to deliver results.

- Get hands-on with the product, data and customer workflows to solve problems, prototype solutions and unblock progress.

- Define and demonstrate success through measurable customer outcomes, holding the vision of what’s genuinely valuable to the organisation beyond explicit deliverables.

Build strategic customer partnerships 

- Develop trusted relationships across complex enterprise organisations, from end users to executive sponsors.

- Identify new use cases, stakeholders and opportunities to deepen the impact of Ankar's technology.

- Partner closely with Account Executives to shape account strategy, build compelling business cases and turn successful deployments into broader enterprise partnerships.

- Communicate complex ideas and results clearly, building conviction and momentum at every level of the organisation.

Help shape the product and how we scale 

- Act as a critical bridge between our customers and our product and engineering teams, translating real-world challenges into product insights and opportunities.

- Identify patterns across deployments that can inform our product roadmap, new capabilities and future market opportunities.

- Develop repeatable approaches, tools and ways of working that help us deliver extraordinary customer outcomes at scale.

- Help shape the deployment function itself as Ankar grows.

What We're Looking For 

Above all, we're looking for exceptional problem solvers with the curiosity, creativity, judgment and drive to make things happen.

You might come from technology, consulting, engineering, product, strategy or an entirely different background. What matters most is how you think, learn and operate.

We value: 

- Intellectual curiosity and analytical rigour. A love for getting to the bottom of complex problems, asking better questions and finding connections others miss.

- Value oriented instincts where you naturally look for opportunities to create value, understand what matters to a business, and can connect technical possibilities to meaningful commercial outcomes.

- Product intuition and technical fluency - excited by technology, comfortable getting hands-on with software and data, and able to work effectively with engineers. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be eager and able to learn.

- Ownership and resourcefulness. A tendency to thrive in ambiguity, take initiative and find ways forward even when there's no established playbook.

- Strong communication and empathy. You build trust with people from very different backgrounds, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and can influence and bring people along without formal authority.

- Adaptability and low ego - you’ll join a team that is willing to roll up their sleeves at any time and task. We index on value, and care more about outcomes than credit.

- A bias for action. You combine big-picture thinking with the willingness and ability to execute.

Bonus points: 

- Experience working with enterprise software, AI, data or complex technical products, particularly in customer-facing roles.

- Founding experience, or experience building a new product or business.

- Experience in R&D-intensive industries such as automotive, semiconductors, advanced materials, chemicals, energy, aerospace or industrial manufacturing, including exposure to complex innovation and product development workflows.

- Familiarity with technical information sources such as scientific literature, patents, experimental results, specifications and research documentation.

- Hands-on experience prototyping, investigating technical problems or analysing data using Python, SQL, APIs or low-code tools.

- Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.

The role involves travel, working closely with customers across the US and Europe. 

Why Ankar? 

You'll join a small, ambitious team at a pivotal moment in Ankar's growth, working at the frontier of AI and enterprise industrial R&D.

You'll help shape not just how our technology is deployed, but how some of the world's most innovative companies work.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with some of the world's leading companies, tackle genuinely complex problems and see the impact of your work firsthand.

You'll have real ownership from day one, a direct influence on the product we're building, and the opportunity to help define how Ankar works with customers as we scale globally.

If this sounds like you - sign up for the mission.

What we put behind our people 

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

- Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

- Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

- Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

- Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

- Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

We're seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded directly inside customer engineering teams, writing the code, building the tooling, integrations and configurations needed to get Blockstream's products into production. Additionally you ship what you build back into the core product.

You will spend significant time working directly alongside customer engineering, operations, and technology teams, often onsite, to understand complex banking environments, solve technical challenges, and deliver production-ready solutions. As the technical bridge between customers and Blockstream, you will play a critical role in accelerating customer success while providing valuable implementation insights that continuously improve our products and delivery methodology.

- Delivery: Own the technical delivery of Blockstream enterprise software from project kickoff through production deployment and post launch support

- Financial Institutions: Work directly with financial institutions to understand business processes, operational workflows, and technical environments.

- Configure, deploy, and optimize Blockstream products based on customer requirements and approved solution designs.

- Deliver administrator and end-user enablement sessions to ensure successful customer adoption.

- Enterprise integration: Integrate with core banking and capital-markets systems.

Engineering & Technical Delivery 

- Controlled environments: Deploy into on-premise, network-isolated, and air-gapped banking environments under formal change control, producing the security and audit evidence that compliance and pen-test reviews require.

- Design and implement integrations between Blockstream enterprise products and customer systems using required integration interfaces and data pipeline technologies.

- Troubleshoot complex technical, configuration, and integration challenges throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure secure, scalable, and production-ready deployments.

- Develop reusable deployment assets, implementation playbooks, technical documentation, and best practices.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering to resolve product issues and improve implementation quality.

Customer Collaboration 

Embed directly with customer teams to gain a deep understanding of their operating environment and technical challenges.

- Facilitate technical workshops, architecture discussions, and implementation planning sessions.

- Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

- Build strong relationships across customer Technology, Operations, Security, and Engineering functions.

Digital Assets Product Improvement Feedback Loop 

- Turn implementation learnings, customer feedback, and product enhancement opportunities into code

- Identify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements and contribute to standardized implementation methodologies.

- Partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap and improve platform capabilities based on real customer implementations.

- Help accelerate customer time-to-production through continuous improvement of deployment frameworks and best practices.

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications): 

- 4-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering, or Enterprise Software Delivery.

- Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust) sufficient to build and ship integrations, tooling and services independently

- Experience implementing and deploying enterprise software solutions within complex customer environments.

- Strong understanding of protocol intermediation, enterprise integration patterns, cloud technologies, security fundamentals and modern software architectures.

- Experience working directly with enterprise customers throughout implementation and deployment projects.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Comfortable collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Consulting teams.

- Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Self-starter with proven ability to work independently while managing multiple customer engagements.

- Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations across Switzerland.

- Excellent English skills are required, German and/or French is strongly preferred. 

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications): 

- Experience working with financial institutions, like private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

- Background in Bitcoin, blockchain, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

- Experience integrating enterprise software using APIs and modern integration frameworks.

- Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerized deployments, or infrastructure automation.

- Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

- Experience contributing product feedback from customer implementations into engineering roadmaps.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

- Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 

- Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.

- Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 

- User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 

- LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation). 

Responsibilities 

- Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 

- Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.

- Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models. 

- Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 

- Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 

- Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 

- Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.

- Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

Required Qualifications: 

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.

- Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 

- Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 

- Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 

- Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.

- Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)

- Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. 

- Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.

title: QA Engineer - Payments
description:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do 

- Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes

- Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.

- Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff

- Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed

- Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence

- Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring 

- Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar. 

- Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.

- Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.

- Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)

- Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.

- An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence

- A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have 

- Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.

- Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp 

- 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up

- 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

- 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

- 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

- 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

- 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

- 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

- 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

- 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Job Application Tip 

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role 

We're hiring a Lead Platform Engineer to own our Google Cloud platform and the route our engineers take to production. You'll spend most of your time designing and building, and you'll manage one infrastructure engineer from day one.

As the business grows we expect the platform team to grow with it, and we'd like you to lead that. You'll report to the Director of Engineering.

What you'll work on 

- Completing the rollout of the next version of our platform while the current one keeps serving live traffic.

- Moving acquired sites, which currently deploy in their own ways, onto a common build and release path.

- Strengthening edge protection and resilience so the platform absorbs traffic spikes and hostile traffic.

- Giving every team clear visibility of what's deployed, when, and how often.

- Defining the route from prototype to production, including the checks a service needs before it goes live.

What you'll be responsible for 

Platform and infrastructure 

- Design, build and run scalable, secure infrastructure on GCP, defined in Terraform.

- Own networking and IAM design, including VPCs, ingress through Traefik, and encryption of data at rest and in transit.

- Make and record architecture decisions for the platform, and keep them visible to the wider team.

- Work with the software engineering team to ensure we’re delivering the right infrastructure at the right time.

- Work with our data engineers on the infrastructure behind BigQuery and our data pipelines.

Delivery and developer experience 

- Own our CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and make deployments quick and repeatable.

- Build self-service tooling so product engineers can ship and run their own services with confidence.

Reliability and security 

- Set up monitoring, logging and alerting using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Prometheus and Grafana.

- Lead root cause analysis after incidents and see the fixes through.

- Build security into the delivery process early, and track and address vulnerabilities across the estate.

- Keep the platform in line with our regulatory obligations and internal policies.

Leadership 

- Line manage and develop our infrastructure engineer, with regular one-to-ones and a clear growth plan.

- Set platform standards and help the iGaming and Rewards tech leads adopt them.

- Shape the platform roadmap with the Director of Engineering and plan how the team grows.

- Hire into the platform team as it expands.

About you 

- Significant experience as a platform, cloud or infrastructure engineer, including time as the senior or lead engineer on a team.

- Deep, hands-on experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

- Strong Terraform skills and experience running infrastructure as code in production.

- Experience building and running CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitHub Actions.

- Solid Docker and Kubernetes experience, including cluster networking and ingress.

- Scripting and programming ability in Python, Go or Bash.

- Experience with observability tooling and with leading incident response.

- Experience mentoring engineers, and a real interest in line management.

- Clear written and spoken English, and comfort explaining technical trade-offs to people outside engineering.

Nice to have 

- TypeScript or JavaScript experience.

- ArgoCD or other GitOps tooling.

- Experience in a regulated industry such as iGaming, fintech or health.

- Experience consolidating infrastructure after an acquisition or major migration.

- Experience building or growing a platform team.

- Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

- Travel Insurance

- Competitive Base Salary

- Company Bonus Scheme

- Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

- Market-Leading Training Programme

- Recognition & Reward Scheme

- Annual Company Conference 

- Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

- Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Credit Reporting
description:
Headquarters: Turkey

URL: https://sezzle.com

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Senior Data Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

- Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation 

- Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data

- Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes 

- Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses 

- Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes 

- Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission 

- Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline 

- Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios 

- Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others 

What We Look For: 

- Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline

- 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic

- Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes

- Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 

- Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence

- Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 

- Fluent in English

- Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- 
Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams

- 
Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools

- 
Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With: 

- Python

- Redshift, PostgreSQL

- Data build tool (dbt) 

- WS, G Suite, Mac

- Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process: 

- Application submitted (you are here)

- Wonderlic test (30-40 min)

- Interview with recruiters (30 min)

- Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging

- Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.

- Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.

- Offer

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
