title: Head of SEO (w/m/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere ganzheitliche SEO-Strategie von Technical SEO über Content bis hin zu Offpage-Maßnahmen – und machst SEO zu einem zentralen Wachstumstreiber für Enpal.

- Du führst und entwickelst das SEO-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch weiter, förderst individuelle Stärken und schaffst eine Kultur aus Eigenverantwortung, Lernen und messbaren Erfolgen.

- Du steuerst die SEO-Roadmap strategisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und orchestrierst alle Maßnahmen entlang messbarer KPIs mit direktem Business Impact.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Communications, Product, Tech und Design zusammen und treibst technische wie inhaltliche SEO-Projekte partnerschaftlich und lösungsorientiert voran.

- Du verantwortest zentrale Technical-SEO-Themen wie Crawlability, Indexierung, Site-Architektur, Core Web Vitals und strukturierte Daten und sorgst für eine nachhaltig skalierbare technische Basis.

- Du entwickelst eine datengetriebene Content- und Linkbuilding-Strategie mit Fokus auf 
E-E-A-T, Keyword-Cluster und organisches Wachstum, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und Autorität kontinuierlich stärkt.

- Du entwickelst eine zukunftsgerichtete GEO-Strategie (Generative Engine Optimization) zur Sichtbarkeit in KI-gestützten Suchmaschinen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) inkl. Content-Optimierung für LLM-Zitationen.

- Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, erkennst Trends und neue Entwicklungen im SEO- und Marketing-Umfeld frühzeitig und nutzt sie, um zu experimentieren, zu lernen und neue Opportunities zu erschließen.

- Du analysierst kontinuierlich Performance-Daten, leitest strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab und kommunizierst Erfolge, Learnings und nächste Schritte transparent an das C-Level.

Dein Profil 

- Du bringst 5–7 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung mit und kannst nachweisliche Erfolge in der Steigerung organischer Sichtbarkeit, Traffic-Wachstum und Lead-Generierung vorweisen.

- Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Führungserfahrung – idealerweise beim Aufbau, der Entwicklung oder Skalierung von SEO-Teams – und verstehst es, Menschen zu befähigen und mitzunehmen.

- Du verfügst über tiefgehende Expertise in allen SEO-Disziplinen: Technical SEO, On-Page, Content-Strategie und Offpage/Linkbuilding – und weißt, wie du diese strategisch miteinander verzahnst.

- Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen SEO-Tools wie Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Sistrix, Google Analytics, Audisto oder Screaming Frog.

- Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Developer-Teams und bringst ein solides technisches Verständnis mit (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs).

title: Test Engineer
description:
Job Description 

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Rigorous testing is what turns a promising prototype into a product our customers can trust – and what gets us from validated prototype to Alpha customer readiness to volume shipments.

As Test Engineer, you will design and execute test plans for our power conversion systems – from functional and target-parameter verification through stability, endurance and load testing. You will build and maintain the test setups that validate our hardware and firmware, and work closely with Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical engineers to track down and resolve issues.

It is a unique opportunity to shape the test strategy of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities 

• Design and execute test plans for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems – functional tests, stability tests, endurance (soak) tests, and load tests.

• Build and maintain test setups for prototype, pilot and production units, including medium-voltage test benches.

• Support prototype validation and target-parameter verification (form factor, efficiency, stability) for our Prototype milestone.

• Support qualification testing for Alpha customer deployments – full target-parameter verification, certification test support, and release tests for volume delivery.

• Develop test automation scripts and tools to increase test coverage and reduce manual test effort.

• Collaborate with the Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical teams to diagnose and root-cause test failures.

• Document test procedures, results and reports; maintain traceability for certification and quality purposes.

• Support the definition and specification of end-of-line (EOL) test equipment for volume production, working with our EOL test equipment vendor.

• Support field testing and diagnostics for units deployed at customer sites as needed.

Qualifications 

• BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, electronics engineer (Elektroniker EFZ), automation engineer (Automatiker EFZ) or comparable education.

• 3+ years of experience in test engineering, ideally for power electronics or medium-voltage systems.

• Experience with medium-voltage high-power test setups and lab safety protocols and practices.

• Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar).

• Understanding of power electronics test methods (efficiency, thermal, load and stability testing).

• Strong documentation and analytical skills.

• Team player, comfortable working hands-on in the lab with cross-functional teams.

• Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

• The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Benefits 

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) + Market Interactions, Paris (Français & Anglais)
description:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL)

Lieu : Location: Paris, France — (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)

Team: Product Management

Contrat : CDI 

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités. 

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais. 

À propos de Kaluza 

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez 

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery. 

Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre). 

- Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises.

- Devenir le partenaire de confiance du client : travailler main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché belge pour comprendre leurs besoins, mener la discovery en ateliers afin de définir comment le produit fonctionne et de cadrer le périmètre, construire les exigences ensemble et bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vers vous en premier. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite.

- Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

- Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez 

Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes :

- Une expérience avérée de Product Manager , de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.

- Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue.

- De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués.

- Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran.

- Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées.

- La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération.

Nos valeurs 

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

- Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

- Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

- Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

- Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

- Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages 

Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes 

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible here .

Compensation: €46K – €63K

title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer
description:
At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

Job title: Advanced R&D - Physical Design Engineer

Location : Lausanne, Switzerland

The Physical Design (PD) Engineer translates high-speed communication IP digital designs into physical GDSII layouts for advanced FinFET nodes. You will bridge logic design, owning block-to-chip implementation from netlist to final physical sign-off, ensuring PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) targets are met.

Immediate key objective 

- Drive block-level physical implementation—covering synthesis, SDC constraints, floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing—meeting strict frequency, area, and power targets.

- Execute timing closure across multiple corners and modes (MCMM) utilizing static timing analysis (STA) and generating targeted ECOs.

- Drive full physical verification closure sign-off in deep-submicron FinFET technologies.

Responsibility 

- Own block synthesis, floorplanning, placement optimization, CTS, and routing.

- Develop and refine SDC constraints to ensure design intent matches physical realization.

- Collaborate with the digital design team to resolve logic or architectural bottlenecks affecting P&R convergence.

- Generate progress reports, document implementation flows, and prepare sign-off packages for tape-out.

Required Experience 

- 5+ years of hands-on physical design experience focusing on synthesis, SDC constraints, CTS, and place and route for high-speed systems.

- Strong technical background in deep-submicron CMOS/FinFET physical effects, crosstalk, and high-frequency clock network design.

- Proven experience of taking complex blocks from netlist through successful physical implementation.

- Direct experience with advanced low-power implementation techniques (UPF, power gating).

- Proven tape-out experience in advanced FinFET nodes (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm).

- Experience handling complex block-to-chip hierarchical assembly, pin placement, and top-level routing constraints..

Required Skills 

- Expert proficiency with industry-standard implementation and sign-off tools (e.g., Cadence Genus/Innovus/Tempus or Synopsys Design Compiler/ICC2/PrimeTime, and Calibre).

- Deep understanding of SDC creation, and MCMM timing management.

- Strong scripting skills (Tcl, Python) for flow automation and design data analysis.

- Analytical mindset to debug congestion routing issues, and complex timing violations.

- Self-motivated with strong sense of ownership; effective communicator and team player

Required Education 

- Masters or Ph.D. in E.E., Communications or other relevant fields

title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

- Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

- Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

- Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

- Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

- Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

- Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For

A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.

Your Background

- 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.

- Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.

- Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).

- Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.

- Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.

- Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.

Nice to Have

- Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.

- Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).

- Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.

- Robotics or field data collection.

- Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.

What We Offer

- Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

- Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

- Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

- Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

- Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

- Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

What We're Looking For 

Lightning AI is seeking an experienced Senior Storage Infrastructure Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.

In this role, you will focus on building and operating the storage systems that power large-scale AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads. You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and operations—developing automation, improving reliability, and scaling distributed storage systems across our bare-metal infrastructure.

You will help own the data plane of our storage infrastructure, supporting high-throughput, low-latency data access for some of the most demanding AI workloads. You’ll play a key role in managing and evolving our storage stack (including VAST and S3-compatible systems like Ceph), ensuring performance, reliability, and efficiency at scale.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time. 

What You'll Do 

Storage Systems & Infrastructure

- Improve performance, reliability, and efficiency of storage systems supporting large-scale AI/ML workloads

- Troubleshoot complex storage and data path issues across hardware and software layers

- Optimize storage performance to support high-throughput, low-latency AI training and inference workloads

Automation & Tooling 

- Build and maintain automation for provisioning, managing, and monitoring storage infrastructure

- Develop Python-based tools and workflows to reduce manual operational overhead

- Improve lifecycle management of storage clusters, from deployment through maintenance and scaling

Systems & Operations 

- Manage and operate Linux-based systems in production, including bare-metal environments

- Partner with infrastructure and data center teams on hardware bring-up, upgrades, and issue resolution

- Support capacity planning, utilization tracking, and forecasting for storage systems

- Leverage monitoring and telemetry to diagnose issues and improve system performance and reliability

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

- Work closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Network Engineering, and Platform teams to integrate storage into the broader platform

- Contribute to design discussions around new infrastructure deployments and scaling strategies

- Help define best practices for operating storage systems in high-performance computing environments

What You'll Need

title: Research Scientist, Embodied AI
description:
About Niantic Spatial 

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role 

Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI.

Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. You will invent and develop algorithms and systems that sit at the cross-section of computer vision, machine learning, AI, graphics, and robotics.

We're passionate about discovery, so we're looking for scientists who want to learn, publish, teach, and deploy every new invention.

What You'll Do 

- Develop New Spatial Representations - Develop new spatial representations that embodied AI can learn from, train in, and act on.

- Advance Real-to-Sim Pipelines - Advance real-to-sim pipelines connecting real-world observations, 3D reconstruction, simulation, and robotic policy learning.

- Solve Emerging Spatial Problems - Solve emerging problems that relate to spatial intelligence, 3D scene representation, training data, model efficiency, and interactive systems.

- Take Capabilities Through to Evidence - Take new capabilities through to evidence: what changed for the policy, not only what changed in the reconstruction.

- Build Prototypes - Build proof of concept prototypes, initially for internal use, where some will need to run at production scale on customer data.

- Collaborate Across Research and Product - Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product partners to bring novel models to production.

- Publish Your Work - Publish and present your work.

What You'll Bring 

- A PhD in computer vision, robotics, graphics, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience, with a publication record at top venues.

- Substantial expertise in robotics or embodied AI, including experience in sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, policy evaluation, and simulation-based learning.

- Deep experience with 3D scene representations: Gaussian splatting, neural fields, meshes, point clouds, or implicit representations.

- You have applied generative or diffusion models to 3D data, such as scene completion, inpainting, relighting, or novel view synthesis from sparse capture.

- You have worked on 3D semantics, open-vocabulary scene understanding, or scene graphs.

- Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries such as PyTorch.

- GPU or graphics programming experience, such as custom CUDA kernels, shaders, or differentiable rendering.

- A track record of contributing to widely used open-source research codebases.

Nice to Have 

- Proficiency in C++.

title: Staff Performance Engineer, JavaScript Engine (SpiderMonkey)
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.” 

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems. 

What you’ll do: 

- Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector. 

- Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping. 

- Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve. 

- Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved. 

- Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine. 

- Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices. 

- Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams. 

- Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development. 

What you’ll bring: 

- 5+ years developing C++ applications 

- Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines 

- Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software 

- Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.) 

- A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help 

- Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards 

- Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers 

- Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Data Engineer

Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business.

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard , Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.

2. Your Impact

- Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control

- Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)

- Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team

- Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics

- Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience: 

- 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment

- Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems

- Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning

Skills: 

- Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem

- Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks

- Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)

- Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)

- Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark

- French: Fluent (C2 level required)

- English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required)

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

description:
At NerdWallet , we're building tools and experiences that help people make smarter financial decisions. As a Software Engineer focused on AI & Automation within our Security organization, you'll build production software and AI-enabled systems that make security work more scalable, effective, and developer-friendly across NerdWallet.

You'll apply strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on AI experience to automate complex security workflows, build internal platforms and developer tooling, and help us rethink how security engineering operates in an AI-native environment. You do not need to come from a traditional security engineering background. We're looking for an engineer who has built and operated production software and AI-enabled systems, is curious about security, and is excited to develop deeper security expertise while solving meaningful problems at scale.

You'll have room to bring new ideas, influence how AI and automation practices evolve at NerdWallet, and shape a growing area within Security. This role reports to the Security Automation Manager.

Projects you may be working on in this position include: 

- 
Designing and building AI-enabled workflows and multi-agent systems that automate security design review, threat modeling, policy Q&A, vulnerability analysis, and other high-value security processes.

- 
Building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search experiences across large code and documentation repositories.

- 
Creating automated code-review capabilities that help identify insecure patterns and improve software quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

- 
Building production Python services and APIs that power AI-enabled security workflows, with thoughtful architecture, authentication, authorization, testing, observability, and reliability.

- 
Designing and operating scalable pipelines that ingest, process, index, and retrieve large volumes of code, documents, and events.

- 
Improving AI system quality through evaluation frameworks, experiment management, prompt and context management, observability, and evidence-based iteration.

- 
Managing practical production tradeoffs such as latency, reliability, model/provider selection, token usage, and cost.

- 
Designing integrations with GitHub, Slack, Jira, Confluence, LLM providers, and internal services so security guidance fits naturally into engineering workflows.

- 
Applying security controls to AI applications, including prompt injection defenses, sensitive-data handling, access control, supply-chain considerations, and safe model inputs and outputs.

- 
Identifying new opportunities for software, automation, and AI augmentation across the Security team and independently moving high-value ideas from problem definition through production.

Where you can make an impact: 

- 
Own technically meaningful software and AI initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

- 
Help shape how AI and automation are used across NerdWallet Security, including when AI is the right solution and when it is not.

- 
Build tools and platforms that make security easier for engineering teams to adopt and use.

- 
Improve the speed, consistency, and quality of security workflows through thoughtful software design and automation.

- 
Grow into deeper application and AI security expertise while bringing strong software engineering judgment to the team.

- 
Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly and collaborate with engineers, security partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

- 
3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production software.

- 
Strong Python proficiency, including hands-on experience building production backend services and APIs.

- 
Experience designing maintainable backend architectures, including separation of concerns, request/response validation, authentication/authorization, error handling, testing, and observability.

- 
Experience developing distributed or cloud-based systems and making practical decisions about scalability, reliability, and performance.

- 
Hands-on experience building production AI-enabled applications or automations using LLM APIs, agents/tool use, RAG/retrieval, or comparable architectures.

- 
Experience defining, evaluating, and improving the quality of AI-enabled systems in production.

- 
Ability to work through ambiguity, identify opportunities independently, and move technical work from idea to implementation.

- 
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions, tradeoffs, and limitations clearly.

- 
Interest in secure software development and willingness to build deeper expertise in application security and AI security.

This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

-

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

401K with 4% company match

Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) + Market Interactions, Paris (French & English)
description:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle

Location : Location: Paris, France — 3 days a week in office

Team: Product Management

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to 

relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. 

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. 

About Kaluza 

Kaluza reimagines energy to bring net-zero within everyone’s reach. Our intelligent platform enables energy utilities to unlock the full value of a radically changing energy system and propel us to a future where renewable energy is sustainable, affordable and accessible for all.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

At Kaluza we embrace a flexible, hybrid work model that balances autonomy with the power of in-person connection. Many of our teams find value in coming together regularly to collaborate, strengthen relationships, and accelerate progress. We’re focused on shaping thoughtful, team-driven approaches that support both business impact and individual well-being.

We also prioritise meaningful company-wide gatherings like our annual conference and end-of-year celebrations, that bring us together to align, connect, and celebrate.

What will I be doing? 

You will work closely with a team of software engineers on the Belgian expansion of our Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) domain, one of the core product domains of the Kaluza platform. It holds customer, account and contract information and owns the customer journeys around them (for example, moving home or changing contract). It is a full-stack domain: a front end for customer service agents, APIs that expose the data, and back-end services that own the databases and workflow logic. You will therefore work across the whole product domain. This is not a product owner role: you will own features end to end, from dialogue with clients and users to delivery of the software, while running the team’s day-to-day and the discovery work. 

Occasional trips to Belgium are possible (around two per quarter). 

- Translate Belgian market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the Belgian energy market into product requirements

- Become the client’s trusted partner: — work hand in hand with ENGIE and future clients in the Belgian market to understand their needs, run discovery workshops to define how the product works and scope the work, shape requirements together, and build a relationship where they come to you first. That closeness helps you steer what CAL builds next.

- Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, explore API schemas, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.

- Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with a full stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy

Ideally you’ll have/be 

- Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

- Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

- Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.

- A builder's mentality — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.

- Technically comfortable — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one and can hold your own in a technical conversation. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.

- A clear, sharp communicator — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.

- Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.

- Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.

Our Values 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

- Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

- Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

- Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

- Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

- Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks 

- Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

- Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

- Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + 1 birthday day off + bank holidays + RTT days (11), Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Read more about our values over on our careers site. 

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn . You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here .

title: Staff Software Engineer, Ecosystem
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://joinblvd.com 

Who is Boulevard? 

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . 

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. 

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here: 

- Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.

- Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.

- Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.

- Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.

- Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.

- Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.

- Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive: 

- Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.

- Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.

- Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.

- Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.

- Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.

- Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.

- A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.

- A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you: 

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

- Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

- Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

- Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

- An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

- 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

- 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

- Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free. 

- Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success. 

- $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

- And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice .

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. 

Outside Employment Disclosure 
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. If you currently hold such a role, you are still welcome to apply — please raise it early with your recruiter so we can talk it through. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/boulevard-staff-software-engineer-ecosystem

title: Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Full descriptions and apply: https://cardog.app/careers

QA Automation Engineer 

Every person who presses play deserves a product that works, and quality is how we honor them. If you love building systems that catch problems early and see quality as a way to serve people well – we’d love to meet you.

ABOUT US 

Come and See is the faith-based nonprofit media ministry behind The Chosen . Our mission is inviting everyone to encounter Jesus through exceptional storytelling that brings the Bible to life. Our Team Members work together as collaborators in the greatest mission on earth.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

The QA Automation Engineer will build our automated testing strategy and coverage across web, mobile, connected TV, API, and backend platforms, integrate testing into our CI/CD pipelines, and support manual and exploratory testing where automation isn’t yet practical. This is a full-time, remote role open to candidates in the USA.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

- Shape the testing strategy. Help define automation standards, choose the right testing layers for each product, and prioritize by risk, business impact, and effort.

- Champion testability. Advocate for quality throughout the development lifecycle and mentor teammates on where automation adds value and where manual validation still belongs.

- Build automated test suites. Design, write, and maintain tests for critical user journeys, APIs, and integrations, with reusable frameworks, fixtures, and patterns for test data and mocking.

- Keep tests reliable. Diagnose and fix flaky tests, and keep suites maintainable as products and architecture evolve.

- Choose the right tools. Evaluate, prototype, and recommend testing frameworks and services, including AI approaches to test creation and maintenance, before wider adoption.

- Wire testing into CI/CD. Work with Engineering on which tests run for pull requests, builds, deployments, and scheduled regression, and help set quality gates that don’t slow delivery.

- Make quality visible. Improve visibility into test results, failures, and trends, and trace failures to application code, test code, infrastructure, or environments.

- Test what automation can’t. Perform manual, exploratory, and regression testing across supported platforms and devices, and document and help diagnose defects.

- Improve with the team. Work with Product Managers, Engineers, and Product Operations to validate acceptance criteria, learn from recurring defects, and keep improving our practices.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

- 5+ years in software quality assurance, test automation, or software engineering, using modern automated testing frameworks

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests

- Experience testing web applications, APIs, mobile applications, or other digital platforms

- Strong grasp of testing principles, including regression, integration, end-to-end, exploratory, and risk-based testing

- Ability to write code or scripts for test automation, with working knowledge of CI/CD and Git workflows

- Experience diagnosing failures across applications, tests, environments, and integrations

- A personal faith in Jesus and alignment with our mission, values, and Statement of Faith

BONUS POINTS: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, experience establishing or expanding an automated testing program, testing across web, iOS, Android, and connected TV, CI/CD integration, API and integration testing, cloud testing infrastructure or device farms, performance or accessibility testing, e xperience leveraging AI-assisted development or testing tools to improve engineering productivity and test automation , streaming, media, or high-scale consumer product experience, nonprofit or ministry/faith-based organizational experience

BENEFITS: Medical, dental, vision, retirement match, HRA, disability and life insurance, generous and flexible time off, holidays, parental leave, and more.

OUR BELIEFS, CULTURE, AND COMMITMENT 

At Come and See, every staff member is a critical and valuable part of our mission and ministry. We consider ministry readiness and an individual’s capacity to represent our culture and Christian beliefs during the selection process for all staff positions. An essential function within every position held by a staff member at Come and See is to uphold and represent Jesus in how we live and behave.

While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn’t mean uniformity. Our calling is too great, and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team with people from all backgrounds. We believe that varied perspectives—across race, ethnicity, life experience, age, and gender—enrich our ability to share the story of Jesus with the world and help everyone, everywhere, experience the authentic Jesus.

Come and See is an equal opportunity employer and as a religious organization, lawfully exercises its right under Title VII and applicable state law to employ individuals who share its religious beliefs.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: 

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters 
- Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations 
- Lead regional technical initiatives 
- Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support: 

- Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development 
- Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region. 
- Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings 

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance: 

- Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings 
- Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests 
- Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns 
- Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality 
- Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population 
- Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations. 

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison 

- Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units 
- Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests 
- Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends 
- Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria 
- Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence. 

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement 

- Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation 

- Provide Technical expertise on regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals 
- Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities 
- Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities 
- Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact 

Supervision & Autonomy 

- Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy 
- Works independently on technical matters 
- Expected to remain hands-on 
- Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives 
- Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership 

What You'll Need 

Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas: 

- Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries. 
- Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies. 
- Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise. 
- Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis. 
- Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas. 
- Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure. 
- Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data. 
- Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns. 
- Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains. 
- Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations. 
- Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination. 
- Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations. 
- Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities. 
- AI Platforms: Experience working across various AI models, platforms, and tooling including MCP servers and agentic frameworks. Applies AI broadly across security operations — from investigation acceleration and workflow automation to internal capability development, prompt engineering, and driving AI adoption and maturity across the team. 
- Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 

Education:
BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building automated workflows. We expect every new hire to bring genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to working smarter and faster with it.

For some, this means staying open to new tools. For others, it means architecting new systems with AI at the core. We're transparent about expectations for every role, and we give you the tools and support to thrive.

About the Team

You'll join our small central AI team. We help every function at Harmonic, from sales to legal, achieve more with AI. People closest to the work bring the ideas and prototype solutions. We provide the shared platform, standards and guardrails, and turn the ideas with the most impact into AI solutions the whole company benefits from.

About the Role

At Harmonic we use AI to help us operate more effectively and scale as a business. You’ll take what works for one person and make it work for everyone: building skills, agents and workflows with AI at their core, and the shared platform where they are deployed and secured. You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this shared platform, working directly with the VP AI Engineering and with support from senior engineers across Harmonic.

Your time will be split roughly evenly between applied AI engineering , building the solutions, and platform and DevOps , the foundation they run on. Early on there is more platform work, as we set up things like agent deployment and a marketplace for sharing AI tools. As the platform matures, the balance moves towards building.

You'll partner closely with TechOps, Engineering, Security and the business teams we build with.

What You'll Do

You will be building and supporting the solutions and platform that let the whole company scale through AI, taking advantage of the latest vendor tools and capabilities. You'll use AI coding tools every day to do your work.

Applied AI Solutions that Work Company-Wide

- Design and build AI skills, agents and workflows that use the latest models, tools and capabilities, working with the people who do the job.

- Develop colleagues' ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable, cost effective companywide solutions.

- Build and deploy shared AI capabilities as skills, agents, connectors and more.

- Write tests and evaluations from real examples, and run them in CI within cost limits.

- Monitor shared skills, agents and connectors, maintain and tune what's working, retire what isn't used.

- Track, experiment with and evaluate the latest AI vendor features and tools as they are released.

Platform & DevOps: The Foundation Our AI-Powered Solutions Run On

- Build and run shared AI infrastructure as code, reviewed and deployed through CI/CD pipelines, today on AWS, with Terraform and GitLab.

- Deploy and operate secure connectors (MCP servers) so AI can act with the right constraints and permissions, with secrets managed centrally.

- Build the pipeline for publishing, versioning and sharing skills, plugins and other AI tools.

- Maintain and operate scheduled and triggered agents safely, each with its own identity, secrets and monitoring, tracking cost, performance, stability and usage across the platform.

- Help colleagues build on the platform with docs, templates and support.

- Create, document and maintain standards for AI solutions, such as how agents are deployed, so other teams can adopt them.

What You Bring

Engineering foundations 

- Demonstrable experience of hands-on DevOps, platform or cloud engineering in a real software team. A substantial internship on real production software counts.

- Practical cloud infrastructure experience; for example AWS IAM, containers/ECS, S3 and networking basics.

- Experience writing and reviewing infrastructure as code, for example with Terraform or OpenTofu, and shipping changes through CI/CD pipelines with a standard Git workflow.

- Python (or similar) for tooling and automation, plus Linux and Docker basics.

Building with AI 

- Enthusiasm for solving real world problems with AI, shown by something you've built beyond using coding assistants, such as an agent, workflow or integration. A personal, university or work project counts.

- Established day-to-day use of AI coding tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.

- Awareness of the infrastructure and technical ecosystem that supports AI solutions; for example agent hosting platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, MCP services, plugin marketplaces, LLM APIs and SDKs.

Working with colleagues 

- Clear communication with non-engineers: you explain technical choices, trade-offs and limits in plain language, in writing and in conversation.

- Curiosity about how other teams work: you ask questions to understand a colleague’s problem before proposing a solution.

You don't need to have had an AI job title or an AI background, and you don't need to match every requirement.

You Might Be a Fit if You

- Are bright, curious, learn fast, and enjoy being the first person to build something.

- See AI as a tool to help you build smarter, faster and better, and want to point it at problems that have real impact.

- Want to spend at least half your time building AI solutions that colleagues rely on, using the latest tools and capabilities as they emerge.

- Like being the link between engineers and the people who do the work.

- Enjoy switching hats, moving between technical implementation and collaborating with colleagues.

- Like to ship early and iterate.

- Thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve and ambiguity is the norm.

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

- Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice

- Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems

- Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

- Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO

- A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy

- Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output

- Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville

- Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work.
